work.work-title: Rimsky-Korsakov Harmonic Exercises, Free Melodic Figuration

credit.credit-words: General rule: for all listed dissonant you should avoid doubling the resolution tone
in other voices except for root tones in the bass and at least an octave away.
Exceptions can sometimes be the bass of a sixth chord (example m4) and sometimes
the fifth tone of a chord (example m3, m12). Interfering tones in other voices should be lead
away (in the examples this is marked with dashes). All these gestures are intended primarily
for decorating soprano, only occasionally can they be used for other voices.
